description: Return only the mating features of one object: each hole, pin, pocket, slot or socket that meets another part, its exact size, what it mates with, and its fit class (press, slide, run, socket, clamp, designed). Use it before preparing a part to print or machine, or when get_geometry's full sheet is more than you need. All sizes are exact with no clearance: add your process allowance to press, slide, run and socket features only; designed and clamp features stay as drawn. Objects without mating features return an empty list.

object.description: Slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact name or alias also resolves.

name: get_fits
title: Read one object's mating features
